parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Name of the logbook to be created, e.g. "userlog", null-terminated string.Logbook names are currently limited to 10 characters (limit: module name) and are not permitted to begin with the $ character. Names for system logbooks begin with the $ character. Prefixing _$ characters to user logbooks is recommended.Logbooks are currently stored as BR modules and must have a unique name across the entire system!Naming conventionsObserve notes regarding use of application modules.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Length of the log data area in bytes (minimum 4096 bytes).

parameters.name: Persistence
parameters.description: Persistence of the logbook: arEVENTLOG_PERSISTENCE_VOLATILE - Volatile (DRAM) arEVENTLOG_PERSISTENCE_REMANENT - Resistant to warm restarts (USERRAM) arEVENTLOG_PERSISTENCE_PERSIST - Resistant to cold restarts (USERROM) With the arEVENTLOG_PERSISTENCE_REMANENT and arEVENTLOG_PERSIST options, the logbook entries are stored in an image in the DRAM. This image is copied to the respective memory cyclically every 60 seconds and also during an orderly system shutdown. This means that data from the last 60 seconds can be lost in the event of a non-ordered shutdown (PowerFail, Watchdog).

parameters.name: EventId
parameters.description: Event ID of the entry. (see 32-bit event ID)Only customer IDs can be entered. System IDs are rejected with the error arEVENTLOG_ERR_EVENT_ID. A system information entry with error number arEVENTLOG_ERR_EVENT_ID is also created that contains the original event ID in the additional data.The Logger in Automation Studio shows the event ID in decimal format in the ID column. The Format column shows whether the entry is in the event ID or error number format. The SDM shows the event ID in decimal format in the ID column. The severity decoded from the event ID is entered in the Severity column.

parameters.name: OriginRecordID
parameters.description: Record ID of the originating error entry. 0 = no originator.The Logger in Automation Studio indicates the origin record ID with a link in the Origin column. The SDM does not show the origin record ID.

parameters.name: AddDataSize
parameters.description: Length of the additional log data. If 0 is specified, then no additional data is written.[Byte]The length is determined internally for the binary-encoded data format (arEVENTLOG_ADDFORMAT_CODED)! A length does not need to be specified here!

parameters.name: AddDataFormat
parameters.description: Format of the additional log data. 0 - No special format (arEVENTLOG_ADDFORMAT_BINRAY)Formats: 1 - Series of null-terminated strings (arEVENTLOG_ADDFORMAT_TEXT) 2 - Binary-encoded format (arEVENTLOG_ADDFORMAT_CODED) 100-150 - Customer area ASCII strings that are specified are not checked for validity. If special characters outside the ASCII range are specified, then they can be displayed differently depending on the evaluation tool being used! Functions are available to create additional data in binary-encoded form. This format is used so that arguments can be specified for description texts with format items, for example.

parameters.name: AddData
parameters.type: UDINT (given as a pointer to the additional data)
parameters.description: Pointer to the additional data. If NULL is specified, then no additional data is written. The Logger in Automation Studio shows the decoded additional data when possible using the format. In SDM, the additional data is limited and shown in the ASCII data column.

parameters.name: ObjectID
parameters.description: Object ID (description from the creator). If an empty string is specified, the ID is determined by AR (name of the task class)Null-terminated string of max. 35 charactersAllows the user to specify a description for the creator of the logbook entry.The Logger in Automation Studio and SDM show the object ID in the Entered by column.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.type: UDINT(given as a pointer to ArEventLogTimeStampType)
parameters.description: Pointer to external UTC timestamp. If NULL is specified, the UTC timestamp is determined by the AR.The Logger in Automation Studio and SDM shows the timestamp in the Time column converted to the local time of the controller.

parameters.name: StopMode
parameters.description: 0/1/2 If the value 0 (STOP) is given as the SetSpeed, there are three ways to respond. StopMode=0 The motor loses current immediately and spins out. StopMode=1 The speed decelerates (according to the DecPos or DecNeg setting) to 0 and actively brakes if the motor enters generator mode. If the motor is operated in generator mode, the energy flows from the motor back to the DC bus and triggers the DC bus voltage there. => An external braking resistor may be required here. StopMode=2 For the time that the current ramp speed would need (with the configured DecPos or DecNeg deceleration) to ramp to 0, the UDCInject voltage is provided constantly, actively braking the motor. When doing so, the energy in the motor itself is converted to heat and not stored in the DC bus.

parameters.name: Invert
parameters.description: Inversion of the effective direction of the controller using Invert = 1. A positive control deviation e = Fp_set - Fp_act reduces the size of the manipulated variable Qy, i.e. it results in a negative controller gain. Important: Invert = 1 requires that any asymmetrical valve characteristic curves are appropriately manipulated. It is easier to set the Neg_Uy input on the HCRLinValve() to 1 and leave Invert on 0.

parameters.name: Q_man
parameters.description: Valve volume flow in manual operation. Units: [l/min]. Valid value range: -pPID_Para_F->Q_min ≤ Q_man ≤ pPID_Para_F->Q_max. F-y Mode 0x08: In this case, pPID_Para_F->Q_min ≥ -1 and pPID_Para_F->Q_max ≤ 1 are valid, which means Q_man must be limited appropriately, or standardized.

parameters.name: Q_add
parameters.description: Additional volume flow input. Units: [l/min]. Valid value range: -pValve_Para->Qnom_neg ≤ Q_add ≤ pValve_Para->Qnom_pos. This input is also suited for inserting a state space feedback into the control system. F-y Mode 0x08: Here, pValve_Para->Qnom_neg = 1 and pValve_Para->Qnom_pos = 1 are valid, which means Q_add must be standardized accordingly, in order to get reasonable controller behavior.

parameters.name: v_act
parameters.description: Actual speed of the cylinder piston. Units: [mm/s]. Valid value range: -∞ < v_act < ∞. This input is for enabling additional valve volume flow, if the cylinder piston is in motion (v_act ≠ 0) during force control. If v_act is not available as a measurable variable, v_act can be determined from the actual position s_act, if this is measured, using differentiation through a DT1 or DT2 element. If no piston speed compensation is necessary, v_act should be set to 0. In manual operation, v_act = 0 is also assumed.F-y Mode 0x08: In this case, v_act is set equal to 0.Important: In order to internally convert v_act into a volume flow with the unit [l/min], the following relationship is used: Q_act[l/min] = 0.006 * 1 cm * v_act[mm/s]. This means that a standardized cylinder area of 1 cm is used. The actual cylinder piston areas (pSystem_Para->A_Cyl_pos and pSystem_Para->A_Cyl_neg) must be appropriately considered in v_act numerical values.

parameters.name: Qy_Oset_ext
parameters.description: External volume flow offset. Units: [l/min]. Valid value range: -∞ < Qy_Oset_ext < ∞.

parameters.name: Oset_Mode
parameters.description: Selection switch for offset compensation. Valid value range: Oset_Mode Є {00000000, ..., 01111111}. Oset_Mode is configured as a bit array.Bit 0, Bit 1: Addition selection switch. '00': The offset addition is off, which means Qy_Oset_F = 0 und Qy = Qy_F. '01': The offset addition is on and Qy_Oset_F is equivalent to the content of the memory element "Oset-". '10': The offset addition is on and Qy_Oset_F is equivalent to the content of the memory element "Oset+". '11': Not permissible. Bit 2: Trigger for loading both memory elements "Oset+" and "Oset-" with external values (Qy_Oset_ext). '1' activates the loading process for a task cycle. Upon completion of the cycle, bit 2 is automatically reset to 0. Bit 3: Trigger for adding an external value to both of the memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-". '1' activates the addition process for a task cycle. Upon completion of the cycle, bit 3 is automatically reset to 0. Bit 4: Has no function because only external values are available using the variable Qy_Oset_ext. Bit 5, Bit 6: Loading/Addition modes for the memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-". '00': Loading mode: Load both memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-" with the content from Qy_Oset_ext. Addition mode: Add the content from Qy_Oset_ext to both memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-". '01': Loading mode: Load the single memory element "Oset-" with the content from Qy_Oset_ext. Addition mode: Add the content from Qy_Oset_ext to the single memory element "Oset-". '10': Loading mode: Load the single memory element "Oset+" with the content from Qy_Oset_ext. Addition mode: Add the content from Qy_Oset_ext to the single memory element "Oset+". '11': Not permissible. Bit 7: Has no function.

parameters.description: Any changes to the above variables must be applied with Update = (Mode + 1).Servo correction with constant pSupply (Mode = 0x00): Each change to pSupply_max, pSupply, pTank, A_Cyl_pos, A_Cyl_neg, Qnom_pos, Qnom_neg, pDelta_nom, V0_pos, V0_neg, h_Cyl and Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 1. Servo correction with varied pSupply (Mode = 0x02): Each change to pSupply_max, pTank, A_Cyl_pos, A_Cyl_neg, Qnom_pos, Qnom_neg, pDelta_nom, V0_pos, V0_neg, h_Cyl and Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 3. pSupply is normally cyclically updated via an analog input. Servo correction is off (Mode = 0x08): Each change to Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 9. Qy = yValve (Units: [l/min]).

parameters.name: x_Cyl
parameters.description: Current position of the cylinder piston (always based on the cylinder). Units: [mm]. Valid value range: 0 ≤ x_Cyl ≤ h_Cyl. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: v_Cyl
parameters.description: Current speed of the cylinder piston (always based on the cylinder). Units: [mm]. Valid value range: -∞ < v_Cyl < ∞. This input compensates for the influence of the piston speed on the pressure levels in the cylinder chambers. If it is not needed (v_Cyl is negligible or compensation is not desired), it should be set to 0. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pCyl_pos
parameters.description: Chamber pressure for movement in the 'positive' direction. Units: [bar]. Valid value range: 0 ≤ pCyl_pos < pSupply. In order to capture the dynamics of the pressure change in the cylinder pressure chamber, which are responsible for the 'positive' direction of movement, and to bring them into the control loop, this input must be connected with the chamber's pressure gauge. Important - pressure fluctuations that are too large can cause instability in the control loop. Negative values for pCyl_pos result in a warning (see status). Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pCyl_neg
parameters.description: Chamber pressure for movement in the 'negative' direction. Units: [bar]. Valid value range: 0 ≤ pCyl_neg < pSupply. In order to capture the dynamics of the pressure change in the cylinder pressure chamber, which are responsible for the 'negative' direction of movement, and to bring them into the control loop, this input must be connected with the chamber's pressure gauge. Important - pressure fluctuations that are too large can cause instability in the control loop. Negative values for pCyl_neg result in a warning (see status). Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: dF_Cyl_abs
parameters.description: Absolute rate of force increase of the cylinder. Units: [N/s]. Valid value range: -Internal.dF_Cyl_sup < dF_Cyl_abs < Internal.dF_Cyl_sup. dF_Cyl_abs > 0 leads to a force increase, whereas it causes a force decrease with dF_Cyl_abs < 0. This input is preferred for a feed-forward of the force generated by the cylinder. If it is not needed, it should be set to 0. The actual rate of force increase of the cylinder in [N/s] can be calculated as the sum of dF_Cyl_abs + dF_Cyl_rel / 100% * Internal.dF_Cyl_sup. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary, internally, dF_Cyl_abs = 0 is assumed.

parameters.name: dF_Cyl_rel
parameters.description: Relative rate of force increase of the cylinder. Units: [%]. Valid value range: -100 % ≤ dF_Cyl_rel ≤ 100 %. dF_vCyl_rel specifies the rate of change of the force in percent of the theoretical maximum rate of change of the force Internal.dF_Cyl_sup (Units: [N/s]), where Internal.dF_Cyl_sup is always > 0. dF_Cyl_rel > 0 % causes an increase in force, whereas dF_Cyl_rel < 0 % causes a decrease in force. This input is to be connected with the controller output, as this is also operated with percent values. If it is not needed, it should be set to 0. The actual rate of force increase of the cylinder in [N/s] can be calculated as the sum of dF_Cyl_abs + dF_Cyl_rel / 100% * Internal.dF_Cyl_sup. Mode 0x08: Internal calculations use Internal.dF_Cyl_sup = 1.

parameters.name: Qy
parameters.description: Volume flow produced by valve opening yValve. Units: [l/min]. Value range: -Qnom_neg ≤ Qy ≤ Qnom_pos. Qy is needed as input value for the linearization of the valve characteristic curve (see function block HCRLinValve()). Mode 0x08: Here, Qy = yValve (Units: [l/min]).

parameters.name: yValve

parameters.name: enable

parameters.name: pSupply_max
parameters.description: Maximum system pressure (supply pressure). Units: [bar]. Valid value range: pSupply_max ≥ 0. When Update = 1, 3 values less than 0 for pSupply_max result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x00, 0x02: pSupply_max should always be set greater than or equal to the highest expected pSupply value. If pSupply_max < pSupply is entered, then pSupply_max is automatically set equal to pSupply during the update. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pSupply
parameters.description: System pressure (supply pressure). Units: [bar]. Valid value range: pSupply > 0. When Update = 1, 3 values less than or equal to 0 for pSupply result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x02: Here, Update = 3 represents only one initialization of pSupply, given that pSupply is normally updated cyclically. Here, pTank ≤ pSupply ≤ pSupply_max. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pTank
parameters.description: Tank pressure. Units: [bar]. Valid value range: pTank ≥ 0. When Update = 1, 3 negative values for pTank result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0.Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: A_Cyl_pos

parameters.name: A_Cyl_neg

When Update = 1, 3 values less than or equal to 0 for A_Cyl_neg result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: Qnom_pos

Valid value range: Qnom_pos > 0. The value for Qnom_pos can be taken from the valve datasheet. When Update = 1, 3 values less than or equal to 0 for Qnom_pos result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0.Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: Qnom_neg

Valid value range: Qnom_neg > 0. The value for Qnom_neg can be taken from the valve datasheet. When Update = 1, 3 values less than or equal to 0 for Qnom_neg result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0.Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: Neg_y

parameters.name: Update

Servo correction with varied pSupply (Mode = 0x02): Each change to pSupply_max, pTank, A_Cyl_pos, A_Cyl_neg, Qnom_pos, Qnom_neg and Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 3. pSupply is normally cyclically updated via an analog input. Servo correction is off (Mode = 0x08): Each change to Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 9. Qy = yValve (Units: [l/min]).

parameters.name: Fp
parameters.description: Process force. Units: [N]. Permissible value range: -∞ < Fp < ∞. Either the actual value of the force control (more dynamic, but also more instable) or the set value of the force control can be fed to this input.Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Input value. Units: [1]. Valid value range: -1 ≤ u ≤ 1. u actually represents a valve opening, but without compensation for the influence of the process force.

parameters.name: Qy
parameters.description: Volume flow produced by valve opening yValve. Units: [l/min]. Value range: -Qnom_neg ≤ Qy ≤ Qnom_pos. Qy is needed as input value for the linearization of the valve characteristic curve (see function block HCRLinValve()). Mode 0x08: Here, Qy = yValve (Units: [l/min]).

parameters.name: yValve

parameters.name: Tn
parameters.description: Integration time constant (integral action time). Units: [s]. Valid value range: Tn > 0. Tn should be a multiple of the cycle time. It is especially important that Tn is larger than the cycle time. If not, then an appropriate warning is displayed (see status). This check is not executed continually; it is executed only once after the function block is enabled. Values for Tn less than or equal to 0 trigger an error message and reset the y output to 0.

parameters.name: T1
parameters.description: Time constant. Units: [s]. Valid value range: T1 ≥ 0. T1 should be a multiple of the cycle time. It is especially important that T1 is larger than the cycle time. If not, then an appropriate warning is displayed (see status). This check is not executed continually; it is executed only once after the function block is enabled. If T1 = 0, the IT1 behavior reduces to purely I behavior. Negative values for T1 result in an error and reset output y to 0.

parameters.name: tSwitch
parameters.description: Switching time. Units: [s]. Valid value range: tSwitch ≥ 0. tSwitch should be a multiple of the cycle time. It is especially important that tSwitch is at least 5 time larger than the cycle time. If not, then an appropriate warning is displayed (see status). This check is not executed continually; it is executed only once after the function block is enabled and every switch between u1 and u2. When tSwitch = 0 the switch between u1 and u2 is no longer jolt-free. Negative values for tSwitch trigger an error message during the enable phase and reset the y output to 0. parameters.name: pNodeVec

Important! As long as NbNodes = 1, there is no check to see if the node vector pNodeVec is valid, i.e. pNodeVec ≠ 0.

parameters.name: Invert
parameters.description: Invert = 1 inverts the point-to-point linear function 'f(x)'. Also, y = 'f-1(x)', which is based on the inverted node vector [(Y1,X1), (Y2,X2), ..., (Yn,Xn)].

parameters.name: Smooth
parameters.description: Smoothing in the area of around the node (Xi,Yi) of 'f(x)' and (Yi,Xi) of 'f-1(x)'. Valid value range: Smooth Є {0: off, 1: on}.

parameters.name: Rness
parameters.description: Smoothing factor. Valid value range: 0 ≤ Rness ≤ 1000. If too high of a value is selected for Rness, it is automatically limited to the maximum possible smoothing factor Internal.Rness_crit and a warning is triggered (see status).

parameters.name: Update

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Abscissa value of 'f(x)' or 'f-1(x)'. Valid value range: X1 ≤ x ≤ Xn or Y1 ≤ x ≤ Yn. Values outside the permissible area are treated as though they were the next closest end point of the value range.

parameters.name: pNodeVec

Important! As long as NbNodes ≤ 1, there is no check to see if the node vector pNodeVec is valid, i.e. pNodeVec ≠ 0.

parameters.name: Neg_Uy
parameters.description: Neg_Uy = 1 negates the control voltage Uy of the valve, i.e. +10V is reduced to -10V. As a result, a positive valve volume flow Qy leads to a negative voltage value for the valve and an inversion of the effective direction of the upstream controller is achieved without manipulating the nodes on the valve characteristic curve.

If not, then an appropriate warning is displayed (see status). This check is not executed continually; it is executed only once after the function block is enabled. Values for f0 less than or equal to 0 trigger an error message and reset the y output to 0. Please mind that f0 is related to the circular frequency ω0 by f0 = ω0/(2∙Pi).

parameters.name: x_Cyl_min
parameters.description: Minimum value of x_Cyl until a correction of the proportional gain of the position controller has been calculated. Units: [mm]. Valid value range: 0 ≤ x_Cyl_min < x_Cyl_max. If x_Cyl_min = x_Cyl_max = 0, then no correction is made to the proportional gain of the position controller, i.e. Kp_xCorr = 1 for all cylinder piston positions x_Cyl Є [0, h_Cyl].

parameters.name: x_Cyl_max

Valid value range: x_Cyl_min < x_Cyl_max ≤ h_Cyl. If x_Cyl_min = x_Cyl_max = 0, then no correction is made to the proportional gain of the position controller, i.e. Kp_xCorr = 1 for all cylinder piston positions x_Cyl Є [0, h_Cyl].

parameters.description: Rise time. Units [s]. Valid value range: t_rise ≥ 0. During the rise time t_rise, the output value of the ramp generator y rises with y_start to y_hold. The rate of increase of the ramp is determined by t_rise and the difference between y_hold and y_start. t_rise = 0 causes a bypass of this part of the ramp generation and the constant holding phase is immediately executed. Negative values for t_rise trigger an error message and reset the output y to 0. This check takes place at every initiation of a new ramp generation (Init = 1) .

parameters.name: t_hold
parameters.description: Constant holding time. Units [s]. Valid value range: t_hold ≥ 0. During the constant holding time t_hold is valid for the output value of the ramp generator y = y_hold. Selecting t_hold = 0 bypasses this part of the ramp generation and down ramp begins immediately. Negative values for t_hold trigger an error message and reset the output y to 0. This check takes place at every initiation of a new ramp generation (Init = 1) .

parameters.name: t_fall
parameters.description: Fall time. Units [s]. Valid value range: t_fall ≥ 0. During the fall time, t_fall the output value of the ramp generator falls y from y_hold to y_end. The rate of decrease of the ramp is determined by t_fall and the difference between y_end and y_hold. As soon as this part of the ramp generation is reached, t_fall = 0 results in the immediate output of y = y_end. Negative values for t_fall trigger an error message and reset the output y to 0. This check takes place at every initiation of a new ramp generation (Init = 1) .

parameters.name: Oset_Mode
parameters.description: Selection switch for offset compensation. Permissible value range: Oset_Mode Є {00000000, ..., 01111111}. Oset_Mode is configured as a bit array.Bit 0, Bit 1: Addition selection switch. '00': The offset addition is off, which means Qy_Oset_s = 0 und Qy = Qy_s. '01': The offset addition is on and Qy_Oset_s is equivalent to the content of the memory element "Oset-". '10': The offset addition is on and Qy_Oset_s is equivalent to the content of the memory element "Oset+". '11': The offset addition is on and the value of Qy_Oset_s is dependent on the sign of Internal.MoveDir_I. For the positive direction of movement, Qy_Oset_s is equivalent to the content of the memory element "Oset+" and for the negative direction of movement, Qy_Oset_s is equivalent to the content of the memory element "Oset-". Bit 2: Trigger for loading both memory elements "Oset+" and "Oset-" with internal or external values. '1' activates the loading process for a task cycle. Upon completion of the cycle, bit 2 is automatically reset to 0. Bit 3:Trigger for adding an internal or external value to both of the memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-". '1' activates the addition process for a task cycle. Upon completion of the cycle, bit 3 is automatically reset to 0. Bit 4: Source selection switch. Determines whether the memory elements "Oset+" and/or "Oset-" are manipulated with internal ('0') or external ('1') values. The volume flow Internal.Qy_I induced by the integrator is the only available internal source. Using the variable Qy_Oset_ext, any external values can be loaded to the memory elements or added to already existing memory element values. Bit 5, Bit 6: Loading/Addition modes for the memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-". '00': Loading mode: Load both memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-" with the source selected by bit 4. Addition mode: Add the source selected by bit 4 to both memory elements "Oset+" und "Oset-". '01': Loading mode: Load the single memory element "Oset-" with the source selected by bit 4. Addition mode: Add the value of the source selected by bit 4 to the single memory element "Oset-". '10': Loading mode: Load the single memory element "Oset+" with the source selected by bit 4. Addition mode: Add the value of the source selected by bit 4 to the single memory element "Oset+". '11': Loading mode: Load both memory elements "Oset+" and/or "Oset-" depending on the sign of Internal.MoveDir_I. The memory elements "Oset+" and "Oset-" are loaded with the source selected by bit 4for the respective positive and negative directions of movement. Addition mode: The addition takes place depending on the sign of Internal.MoveDir_I. For the positive direction of movement, the source selected by bit 4 is added tothe memory element"Oset+". For the negative direction of movement, the source selected by bit 4 is added tothe memory element"Oset-". Bit 7: Has no function.

parameters.description: Set_home = 1 setzt, falls im Augenblick keine Solltrajektorie abgearbeitet wird, Fp_set = Fp_home, dFp_set = dFp_home und Reached = 1. Dieser Eingang dient vor allem der Synchronisation der Sollkraft und der Sollkraftänderungsgeschwindigkeit mit der aktuellen Istkraft und der aktuellen Istkraftänderungsgeschwindigkeit, um einen geeigneten Bezugspunkt für die weitere Profilgeneration zu bekommen.

parameters.name: Set_home
parameters.description: If no set trajectory is being processed at the moment, setting Set_home = 1 sets Fp_set = Fp_home, dFp_set = dFp_home and Reached = 1. This input is primarily for the synchronization of the set force and the set force rate with the current actual force and the current actual force rate in order to get an appropriate reference point for subsequent the profile generation.

parameters.name: t_delta
parameters.description: Time difference specified for bringing Fp_set from its present value to the end value Fp_end. Units: [s]. Valid value range: t_Jolt < t_delta < ∞. The condition t_delta ≥ 4 · t_Jolt should be maintained for a suitable profile generation.

parameters.name: Fp_end
parameters.description: End value of the set force trajectory. Units: [N]. Valid value range: -∞ < Fp_end < ∞.

parameters.name: Init
parameters.description: Based on the current set force Fp_set and the current set force rate dFp_set, Init = 1 initiates a new trajectory that ends at the point Fp_end (dFp_set = 0). When Fp_end is reached, Reached goes to 1.

parameters.name: Fp_set
parameters.description: Set force. Units: [N]. Value range: -∞ < Fp_set < ∞.

parameters.name: dFp_set
parameters.description: Set force rate. Units: [N/s]. Value range: -∞ < dFp_set < ∞.

parameters.name: t_delta_act
parameters.description: Actual time difference needed for bringing Fp_set to the specified end value Fp_end. Units: [s]. Value range: t_Jolt < t_delta_act < ∞. Generally, t_delta_act deviates from t_delta by just a few task cycles (maximum 4).

parameters.name: Reached
parameters.description: Reached = 1 indicates that end value of the set force has been reached and that the profile generation is complete.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: This function block is only executed if enable = TRUE.

parameters.name: pMove_Para
parameters.description: Movement parameter (t_Jolt, vC_pos, vC_neg, aAcc_pos, aDec_pos, aAcc_neg, aDec_neg).

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.description: Stop = 1 stops trajectory planning. a_set and v_set are set instantly to 0 and s_set retains its last value.

parameters.name: s_home
parameters.description: Homing position. Units: [mm]. Valid value range: -∞ < s_home < ∞.

parameters.name: Set_home
parameters.description: If no set trajectory is being processed at the moment, setting Set_home = 1 sets s_set = s_home and Reached = 1. This input is primarily for the synchronization of the set position with the current actual position in order to get an appropriate reference point for subsequent movements.

parameters.name: s_end
parameters.description: End position of the trajectory. Units: [mm]. Valid value range: -∞ < s_end < ∞.

parameters.name: Init
parameters.description: Based on the current set position s_set and the current set speed v_set, Init = 1 initiates a new trajectory that ends at the point s_end. When s_end is reached, Reached goes to 1.

parameters.name: Brake
parameters.description: Based on the current values of s_set and v_set, Brake = 1 stops the movement with the delay pMove_Para->aDec_pos (positive direction) or pMove_Para->aDec_neg (negative direction). After the braking proceedure has come to an end, a_set = 0, v_set = 0 and Reached = 1.

parameters.name: s_set
parameters.description: Set position. Units: [mm]. Value range: -∞ < s_set < ∞.

parameters.name: v_set
parameters.description: Set speed. Units: [mm/s]. Value range: -pMove_Para->vC_neg ≤ v_set ≤ pMove_Para->vC_pos.

parameters.name: a_set
parameters.description: Set acceleration. Units: [mm/s²]. Value range: -max(pMove_Para->aDec_pos, pMove_Para->aDec_neg) ≤ a_set ≤ max(pMove_Para->aAcc_pos, pMove_Para->aAcc_neg).

parameters.name: MoveDir
parameters.description: Direction of movement. Value range: {-3,-2,-1: negative direction of movement (-3: Deceleration phase, -2: Constant speed phase, -1: Acceleration phase), 0: standstill, 1,2,3: positive direction of movement (1: Acceleration phase, 2: Constant speed phase, 3: Deceleration phase)}.

parameters.name: ApproachDir
parameters.description: Approach direction indicates in which direction the end position s_end is reached. Value range: {-1: negative approach direction, 0: undefined, 1: positive approach direction}.

parameters.name: Reached
parameters.description: Reached = 1 indicates that the end position has been reached and that the movement is complete.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: This function block is only executed if enable = TRUE.

parameters.name: pSupply_max
parameters.description: Maximum system pressure (supply pressure). Units: [bar]. Valid value range: pSupply_max ≥ 0. When Update = 1, 3, 5 values less than 0 for pSupply_max result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x00, 0x02: pSupply_max should always be set greater than or equal to the highest expected pSupply value. If pSupply_max < pSupply is entered, then pSupply_max is automatically set equal to pSupply during the update. Mode 0x04: pSupply_max should always be set greater than or equal to 2 * pDelta_nom. If pSupply_max < 2 * pDelta_nom is entered, then pSupply_max is automatically set equal to 2 * pDelta_nom during the update. Mode 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pSupply
parameters.description: System pressure (supply pressure). Units: [bar]. Valid value range: pSupply > 0. When Update = 1, 3 values less than or equal to 0 for pSupply result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x02: Here, Update = 3 represents only one initialization of pSupply, given that pSupply is normally updated cyclically. Here, pTank ≤ pSupply ≤ pSupply_max. Mode 0x04: The system pressure pSupply is assumed as 2 * pDelta_nom for internal calculations. Mode 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pTank
parameters.description: Tank pressure. Units: [bar]. Valid value range: pTank ≥ 0. When Update = 1, 3 negative values for pTank result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x04, 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: A_Cyl_pos
parameters.description: Cylinder piston area whose pressurization induces a movement in the positive direction (e.g. extending piston). Units: [cm]. Valid value range: A_Cyl_pos > 0. When Update = 1, 3, 5, 7 values less than or equal to 0 for A_Cyl_pos result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: A_Cyl_neg
parameters.description: Cylinder piston area whose pressurization induces a movement in the negative direction (e.g. retracting piston). Units: [cm]. Valid value range: A_Cyl_neg > 0. When Update = 1, 3, 5, 7 values less than or equal to 0 for A_Cyl_neg result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: Qnom_pos
parameters.description: Nominal valve-volume flow, which, together with A_Cyl_pos results in a movement in the positive direction (e.g. extending piston). Units: [l/min]. Valid value range: Qnom_pos > 0. The value for Qnom_pos can be taken from the valve datasheet. When Update = 1, 3, 5, 7 values less than or equal to 0 for Qnom_pos result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0.Mode 0x06: The default Qnom_pos = 0 is permitted, but Qy = yValve is then valid (Units: [l/min]). Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: Qnom_neg
parameters.description: Nominal valve-volume flow, which, together with A_Cyl_neg results in a movement in the negative direction (e.g. retracting piston). Units: [l/min]. Valid value range: Qnom_neg > 0. The value for Qnom_neg can be taken from the valve datasheet. When Update = 1, 3, 5, 7 values less than or equal to 0 for Qnom_neg result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0.Mode 0x06: The default Qnom_neg = 0 is permitted, but Qy = yValve is then valid (Units: [l/min]). Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pDelta_nom
parameters.description: Nominal pressure drop at valve edge. Units: [bar]. Valid value range: pDelta_nom > 0. Typical values are 5 bar or 35 bar. The actual value can also be taken from the valve datasheet. When Update = 1, 3, 5 values less than or equal to 0 for pDelta_nom result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: yValve_0
parameters.description: Valve overlap. Units: [1]. Permissible value range: 0 ≤ yValve_0 < 1. If the valve used is a zero overlap valve, select the value 0 for yValve_0. If the valve is positively overlapped, yValve_0 must be > 0 (yValve_0 = 0.2 for a 20 % overlap). The actual value for yValve_0 can be taken from the valve datasheet. When Update = 1, 3, 5 values outside the valid range for yValve_0 result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary, internally, yValve_0 = 0 is assumed.

parameters.name: yValve_min
parameters.description: Minimum valve opening (|yValve| ≥ yValve_min). Units: [1]. Valid value range: 0 ≤ yValve_min ≤ 1. yValve_min can be used for fine positioning, but generally this value should be set to 0. When Update = 1, 3, 5 values outside the valid range for yValve_min result in an error, and the outputs yValve and Qy are reset to 0. Mode 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary, internally, yValve_min = 0 is assumed.

parameters.name: Neg_y
parameters.description: Negative values for the valve opening yValve result in a positive speed, and vice versa (inverted valve behavior). However, this feature is not needed for standard valves, and Neg_y should be set to 0.

parameters.name: Update
parameters.description: Any changes to the above variables must be applied with Update = (Mode + 1).Servo correction with constant pSupply (Mode = 0x00): Each change to pSupply_max, pSupply, pTank, A_Cyl_pos, A_Cyl_neg, Qnom_pos, Qnom_neg, pDelta_nom, yValve_0, yValve_min and Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 1. Servo correction with varied pSupply (Mode = 0x02): Each change to pSupply_max, pTank, A_Cyl_pos, A_Cyl_neg, Qnom_pos, Qnom_neg, pDelta_nom, yValve_0, yValve_min and Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 3. pSupply is normally updated cyclically via an analog input. Advanced Kp-switching when changing direction (mode = 0x04): Each change to pSupply_max, A_Cyl_pos, A_Cyl_neg, Qnom_pos, Qnom_neg, pDelta_nom, yValve_0, yValve_min und Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 5. If the valve data is known, this mode is preferred over mode 0x06. Simplified Kp-switching when changing direction (mode = 0x04): Each change to A_Cyl_pos, A_Cyl_neg, Qnom_pos, Qnom_neg and Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 7. Default values other than 0 are not mandatory for Qnom_pos and Qnom_neg. However, Qy = yValve (Units: [l/min]). Servo correction is off (Mode = 0x08): Each change to Neg_y must be applied by setting Update = 9. Qy = yValve (Units: [l/min]).

parameters.name: pCyl_pos
parameters.description: Chamber pressure for movement in the 'positive' direction. Units: [bar]. Valid value range: 0 ≤ pCyl_pos < pSupply. In order to capture the dynamics of the pressure change in the cylinder pressure chamber, which are responsible for the 'positive' direction of movement, and to bring them into the control loop, this input must be connected with the chamber's pressure gauge. Important - pressure fluctuations that are too large can cause instability in the control loop. Negative values for pCyl_pos result in a warning (see status). Mode 0x04, 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: pCyl_neg
parameters.description: Chamber pressure for movement in the 'negative' direction. Units: [bar]. Valid value range: 0 ≤ pCyl_neg < pSupply. In order to capture the dynamics of the pressure change in the cylinder pressure chamber, which are responsible for the 'negative' direction of movement, and to bring them into the control loop, this input must be connected with the chamber's pressure gauge. Important - pressure fluctuations that are too large can cause instability in the control loop. Negative values for pCyl_neg result in a warning (see status). Mode 0x04, 0x06, 0x08: Entry not necessary.

parameters.name: vCyl_abs
parameters.description: Absolute speed of cylinder movement. Units: [mm/s]. Valid value range: -Internal.vCyl_sup < vCyl_abs < Internal.vCyl_sup. vCyl_abs > 0 results in a movement in the 'positive' direction, while vCyl_abs < 0 results in a movement in the opposite direction. This input should preferably be used for speed input control for the cylinder movement. If it is not needed, it should be set to 0. The actual cylinder speed in [mm/s] can be calculated as the sum of vCyl_abs + vCyl_rel / 100 % * Internal.vCyl_sup. Mode 0x06: Internally, Internal.vCyl_sup = 1 is assumed, i.e. for vCyl_abs, |vCyl_abs| ≤ 1 is valid. This means if speed input control of the cylinder movement is desired, it must be appropriately standardized, so vCyl_abs remains within its limits. Mode 0x08: Entry not necessary, internally, vCyl_abs = 0 is assumed.

parameters.name: vCyl_rel
parameters.description: Relative speed of cylinder movement. Units: [%]. Valid value range: -100 % ≤ vCyl_rel ≤ 100 %. vCyl_rel is the speed in percent of the theoretical maximum speed of movement Internal.vCyl_sup (Units: [mm/s]), where Internal.vCyl_sup is always > 0. vCyl_rel > 0 % results in a movement in the positive direction, while vCyl_rel < 0 % results in a movement in the opposite direction. This input is to be connected with the controller output, as this is also operated with percent values. If it is not needed, it should be set to 0. The actual cylinder speed in [mm/s] can be calculated as the sum of vCyl_abs + vCyl_rel / 100 % * Internal.vCyl_sup. Mode 0x06, 0x08: Internal calculations use Internal.vCyl_sup = 1.

parameters.name: Zero_yValve
parameters.description: Setting this input results in the immediate output of yValve = 0 and Qy = 0. Zero_yValve can be used for fine positioning, but should normally remain at 0.

parameters.name: Qy

Qy is needed as input value for the linearization of the valve characteristic curve (see function block HCRLinValve()). Mode 0x06: If Qnom_pos = 0 or Qnom_neg = 0, then Qy = yValve (Units: [l/min]). parameters.name: yValve

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the individual inputs and adds an offset Bits 0 to 5 correspond to inputs Comp1 to Comp6. This allows all comparators to be enabled and disable independently of one another. Bits 8 to 15 include an offset value. This offset is added to the input connection number Comp1 to Comp6 when the comparator event occurs. (See example for output Out)1)

parameters.name: Comp1 to Comp6
parameters.description: Offset of the respective comparator from the base timestamp. An offset of 0 is not permitted.When a comparator is enabled and unlocked, then the comparison is performed: (Internal time) - Base >= Compx. If the comparison condition is met, the number of the comparator input is output and the input is locked for new comparisons. The comparator is only active when bit 0 of the set offset time parameter Compx is not equal to 0.

parameters.name: Base
parameters.description: Base timestamp for the comparison. A rising edge on Bit 0 of the Base value unlocks the enabled comparators and sets the output values to 0. Changing the Base value while comparators are running affects the timing with respect to the new base timestamp.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Mode of the comparator: Bit 00: conversion mode (0 = triggered, 1 = cyclic) Bit 01: comparator functions (0 = OFF, 1 = ON) Bit 02: TPU channel F (0 = comparator input, 1 = Trigger-Output) Bit 01 can be used to globally disable the comparator function. When this is done, all comparator outputs (TPU inputs) are set to "0". Bit 02 is only used during reinitialization (<enable> 0 -> 1).

parameters.name: Trig
parameters.description: A positive edge (0 -> 1) at this input can start measurement for all 6 inputs (in trigger mode).

parameters.name: CmpMode0
parameters.description: Comparator mode analog input 0: Bit 00: Comparator output to TPU channel C Bit 01: Comparator output to TPU channel D Bit 02: Comparator output to TPU channel E Bit 03: Comparator output to TPU channel F (only when not triggered by TPU channel F) Bit 04: Inverted comparator output A comparator output can supply more than one TPU channel. Also, several comparator outputs can supply just one TPU channel (caution when evaluating: the comparator signal can pulse).

Bit 15: Error suppression if range overflow for k or d (0 = OFF, 1 = ON). When error suppression is active, the recalculated analog values will be used, despite the error. In this case the corresponding error message will be triggered on the <Error> output.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Offset. The 2 high value bytes are the whole numbers, the 2 low value bytes are the numbers after the decimal point (:= d * 65536).

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Scaling factor. The 2 high value bytes are the whole numbers, the 2 low value bytes are the numbers after the decimal point (:= k * 65536).

parameters.description: Bit 0: Bit 0 = 0: d with respect to physical value Bit 0 = 1: d with respect to converter value Bit 1: Bit 1 = 0: normal mode / output mode Bit 1 = 1: inverted mode / read mode Bit 14: Error suppression if k = 0 (0 = OFF, 1 = ON). parameters.description: Bit 0: Bit 0 = 0: d with respect to physical value Bit 0 = 1: d with respect to converter value Bit 1: Bit 1 = 0: normal mode / output mode Bit 1 = 1: inverted mode / read mode Bit 14: Error suppression if k = 0 (0 = OFF, 1 = ON). Bit 15: Error suppression if range overflow for k or d (0 = OFF, 1 = ON). When error suppression is active, the recalculated analog values will be used, despite the error. In this case the corresponding error message will be triggered on the <Error> output.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Offset. The 2 high value bytes are the whole numbers, the 2 low value bytes are the numbers after the decimal point (:= d * 65536).

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Scaling factor. The 2 high value bytes are the whole numbers, the 2 low value bytes are the numbers after the decimal point (:= k * 65536).

parameters.description: $0000 : no error $0001 : TPU manager not found $0002 : TPU manager version error $0003 : required function (Code) not found $0004 : incorrect I/O configuration $0008 : incorrect value, range exceeded $0010 : fatal error channel management $0011 : channel busy $0020 : fatal error Link management $0021 : incorrect Link channel (receiver) given $0022 : stated Link channel (receiver) busy $0023 : stated Link is not a Link receiver $0030 : incorrect hardware for function $0031 : incorrect hardware configuration for function $8000 : error during deinitialization (FBK was called several times)

parameters.name: Error
parameters.description: Bit 0: internal factor ki is 0 Bit 1: range overflow on internal factor ki Bit 2: range overflow on internal offset di These bits will be set despite error suppression (see bits 14 and 15 of the input parameter <Mode>).

parameters.name: enable

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: FBK mode: Bit 00: Conversion mode (0 = triggered, 1 = cyclic) Bit 01: the function off: 0 OFF, 1 ON Bit 02: FIFO function: 0 OFF, 1 ON Bit 03: FIFO mode: 0 single shot, 1 cyclic Bit 04: free Bit 05: free Bit 06*: TPU channel E: 0 comparator input, 1 FIFO Status Input Bit 07*: TPU channel F: 0 comparator input, 1 trigger output * is only used during reinitialization (<enable> 0 -> 1).

parameters.name: Trig
parameters.description: A positive edge (0 -> 1) at this input can start measurement for all 6 inputs (in trigger mode).

parameters.name: CmpMode0
parameters.description: Comparator mode input 0: Bit 00: SEL0, comparator output to TPU channel C Bit 01: SEL1, comparator output to TPU channel D Bit 02: SEL2, comparator output to TPU channel E* Bit 03: SEL3, comparator output to TPU channel F* Bit 04: INV0, invert comparator result CMP0 Bit 05: ENA0, enable comparator result CMP0 Bit 06: INV1, invert comparator result CMP1 Bit 07: ENA1, enable comparator result CMP1 Bit 08: MODE, 0 exclusive OR, 1 AND * is only possible if channels are configured as comparator inputs

parameters.description: Comparator mode input 5: (see <CompMode0>)

parameters.description: Pointer to allocated FIFO buffer memory

parameters.name: FifoCnt
parameters.description: Number of measurements which should be stored in the FIFO (only even numbers are allowed).

parameters.name: CmpStatus
parameters.description: Status of the comparator outputs: Bit 00: Status of the comparator 0 = TPU channel C Bit 01: Status of the comparator 1 = TPU channel D Bit 02: Status of the comparator 2 = TPU channel E * Bit 03: Status of the comparator 3 = TPU channel F * * The status of these comparator outputs are also displaied if the channels are used for FIFO mode.

parameters.name: FifoReady
parameters.description: Only for FIFO mode Single Shot. (<Mode> Bit 03): 0: Single shot measurement not yet finished 1: Single shot measurement finished. Analog values are stored in FIFO buffer.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: 1 : FBK is executed 0 : FBK inactive A positive edge at <enable> (0 -> 1) triggers reinitialization. The analog inputs are recalibrated (<status> = $8000). Calibration can take up to 50 msec.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Mode of the comparator: Bit 00: conversion mode (0 = triggered, 1 = cyclic) Bit 01: comparator functions (0 = OFF, 1 = ON) Bit 02: TPU channel F (0 = comparator input, 1 = Trigger-Output) Bit 01 can be used to globally disable the comparator function. When this is done, all comparator outputs (TPU inputs) are set to "0". Bit 02 is only used during reinitialization (<enable> 0 -> 1).

parameters.name: Trig
parameters.description: A positive edge (0 -> 1) at this input can start measurement for all 6 inputs (in trigger mode).

parameters.name: CmpMode0
parameters.description: Comparator mode analog input 0: Bit 00: Comparator output to TPU channel C Bit 01: Comparator output to TPU channel D Bit 02: Comparator output to TPU channel E Bit 03: comparator output to TPU channel F (only when not triggered by TPU channel F) Bit 04: Inverted comparator output A comparator output can supply more than one TPU channel. Also, several comparator outputs can supply just one TPU channel (caution when evaluating: the comparator signal can pulse).

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: The <Mode> is bit coded. Every bit corresponds to a channel: Bit 00: channel 0 Bit 01: channel 1 Bit 02: channel 2 Bit 03: channel 3, etc If bit xx = 0, the channel is configured as an input. If bit xx = 1, the channel is configured as an output. Important: Due to the IP161 hardware, the channels can only be configured in pairs.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Bit 0: Bit 0 = 0: d with respect to physical value Bit 0 = 1: d with respect to converter value Bit 1: Bit 1 = 0: normal mode / output mode Bit 1 = 1: inverted mode / read mode Bit 14: Error suppression if k = 0 (0 = OFF, 1 = ON). Bit 15: Error suppression if range overflow for k or d (0 = OFF, 1 = ON). When error suppression is active, the recalculated analog values will be used, despite the error. In this case the corresponding error message will be triggered on the <Error> output.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Offset. The 2 high value bytes are the whole numbers, the 2 low value bytes are the numbers after the decimal point (:= d * 65536).

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Scaling factor. The 2 high value bytes are the whole numbers, the 2 low value bytes are the numbers after the decimal point (:= k * 65536).

parameters.name: RefMode
parameters.description: This value determines the type of referencing. 0 - Direct referencing: The input for the reference signal has no effect. If a positive edge (0 -> 1) occurs at <RefTrig>, <RefPos> will be copied to the actual position. 1 - Referencing when positive edge at reference input occurs: A positive edge at (0 -> 1) <RefTrig> will cause <RefPos> to be copied to the actual position when the next reference pulse occurs. 2 - Referencing when negative edge at reference input occurs: A positive edge (0 -> 1) at <RefTrig> will cause <RefPos> to be copied to the actual position when the next negative edge of the reference input occurs.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: A positive edge at <Start> (0 -> 1) starts measurement (as well as in cyclic and trigger operation), and the outputs <RdyCnt> and <OvlCnt> are set to 0. If the measurement is to be repeated, <Start> must be set to 0 for one cycle.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: This value determines which time of the input signal should be measured by the function and whether the measurement should be performed cyclically. The value also determines which input edges are used for measurement. If this value should be changed, measurement must be restarted (positive edge at <Start>). Cyclic operation: Measurement taken cyclically after a positive edge at <Start> (0 -> 1). 0 : Hightime will be measured over <PCnt> periods 1 : Off time will be measured over <PCnt> periods 2 : Period length will be measured over <PCnt> periods (from positive to positive edge) 3: Period duration will be measured over <PCnt> periods (from negative edge to negative edge) Trigger operation: The measurement is taken only once after a positive edge when <Start> (0 -> 1). The next measurement is not started until after another positive edge at <Start>. 4 :Hightime will be measured over <PCnt> periods 5 : Off time will be measured over <PCnt> periods 6 : Period length will be measured over <PCnt> periods (from positive to positive edge) 7: Period duration will be measured over <PCnt> periods (from negative edge to negative edge) <Mode> 0 to 7: Negative and positive edges of the frequency input are evaluated. <Mode> 8 to 15: Only the negative edges of the frequency input are evaluated. <Mode> 16 to 23: Only the positive edges of the frequency input are evaluated.

parameters.name: PCnt
parameters.description: Number of periods/pulses (1 up to a maximum 232-1) over which measurements should be taken. <PCnt> can be changed during cyclic operation. The new value becomes active in the next measurement cycle.

parameters.name: RdyCnt
parameters.description: After every valid measurement (<DifCnt> recalculated) <RdyCnt> is incremented by 1. In this way every measurement result can be uniquely identified.

parameters.name: OvlCnt
parameters.description: When the internal counter has an overrun, <OvlCnt> is incremented by 1. A positive edge at <Start> will reset <OvlCnt> to 0 (Warning in cyclic operation!). This enables gate times with more than 232-1 counter increments (<DifCnt>) to be detected and measured.

parameters.name: PRest
parameters.description: Number of periods/pulses still to measured in the current measurement cycle. <PRest> will be set to the value of <PCnt> at the start of each measurement.

parameters.name: DifCnt
parameters.description: Counter increment (measurement range 0 to 232-1) for <PCnt> periods/pulses. The counter is set to the frequency input.

parameters.name: DifPer
parameters.description: This output parameter indicates the number of periods over which <DifCnt> was measured. Without this value, if <PCnt> is changed, the point in a cycle when a measurement was taken cannot be determined precisely.

parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. ... how the digital input behaves when a link is received. The functions are bit coded. More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Links are sent: Bit 00: if a Link is received when input is "0" (link bridge) Bit 01: if a Link is received when input is "1" (link bridge) Bit 02: if a negative edge occurs on the input Bit 03: if a positive edge occurs on the input When a link is received: Bit 04: <EdgeCnt> will be latchted in <LatchCnt> (if input is "0") Bit 05: <EdgeCnt> will be latchted in <LatchCnt> (if input is "1")

parameters.name: LnkChan
parameters.description: Number of the channel to which links should be sent: $00 = TPU channel 1 $01 = TPU channel 2 ... $0E = TPU channel 15 $0F = TPU channel 16

parameters.name: LoFilter
parameters.description: Filter time low (max. $7F80). The lower 7 bits are not evaluated (128 ticks resolution).

parameters.name: HiFilter
parameters.description: Filter time high in ticks (max. $7F80). The lower 7 bits are not evaluated (128 ticks resolution).

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: This parameter determines which exception tasks are executed in response to input changes and links received. The functions are bit coded. More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Exception task 0 executed in response to: Bit 00: negative edge at input Bit 01: positive edge at input Bit 02: link received when input status is "0" Bit 03: link received when input status is "1" Exception task 1 executed in response to: Bit 04: negative edge at input Bit 05: positive edge at input Bit 06: link received when input status "0" Bit 07: link received when input status is "1" Manual start of exception tasks: Bit 14: manual start exception task 0 Bit 15: manual start exception task 1

parameters.name: ExcNr0
parameters.description: Exception number for exception task 0. Exception tasks 192 to 207 are reserved (should be used) in the system for the TPU functions. The function supports calling of all exception tasks (1 to 255).

parameters.name: ExcNr1
parameters.description: Exception number for exception task 1. Exception tasks 192 to 207 are reserved (should be used) in the system for the TPU functions. The function supports calling of all exception tasks (1 to 255).

More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Links are sent: Bit 00: if a Link is received when input is "0" (link bridge) Bit 01: if a Link is received when input is "1" (link bridge) Bit 02: if a negative edge occurs on the input Bit 03: if a positive edge occurs on the input When a link is received: Bit 04: <EdgeCnt> will be latchted in <LatchCnt> (if input is "0") Bit 05: <EdgeCnt> will be latchted in <LatchCnt> (if input is "1")

parameters.name: LnkChan
parameters.description: Number of the channel to which links should be sent: $00 = TPU channel 1 $01 = TPU channel 2 ... $0E = TPU channel 15 $0F = TPU channel 16

parameters.name: LoFilter
parameters.description: Filter time low (max. $7F80). The lower 7 bits are not evaluated (128 ticks resolution).

parameters.name: HiFilter
parameters.description: Filter time high in ticks (max. $7F80). The lower 7 bits are not evaluated (128 ticks resolution).

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: This parameter determines which exception tasks are executed in response to input changes and links received. The functions are bit coded. More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Exception task 0 executed in response to: Bit 00: negative edge at input Bit 01: positive edge at input Bit 02: link received when input status is "0" Bit 03: link received when input status is "1" Exception task 1 executed in response to: Bit 04: negative edge at input Bit 05: positive edge at input Bit 06: link received when input status "0" Bit 07: link received when input status is "1" Manual start of exception tasks: Bit 14: manual start exception task 0 Bit 15: manual start exception task 1

parameters.name: ExcNr0
parameters.description: Exception number for exception task 0. Exception tasks 192 to 207 are reserved (should be used) in the system for the TPU functions. The function supports calling of all exception tasks (1 to 255).

parameters.name: ExcNr1
parameters.description: Exception number for exception task 1. Exception tasks 192 to 207 are reserved (should be used) in the system for the TPU functions. The function supports calling of all exception tasks (1 to 255).

parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. ... how the digital input behaves when a link is received. The functions are bit coded. parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. ... how the digital output responds when a link is received. The functions are bit coded. More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Links are sent: Bit 00: if a link is received when output is "0" (Link bridge) Bit 01: if a link is received when output is "1" (Link bridge) Bit 02: if a positive edge occurs at the output Bit 03: if a negative edge occurs at the output When a link is received: Bit 04: the output is set to "1" after <LoHiDelay> (if output is "0") Bit 05: the output is set to "0" after <HiLoDelay> (if output is "1") Important: If the delay is not yet over and a link is received, the link will be ignored as a trigger input.

parameters.name: LnkChan
parameters.description: Number of the channel to which links should be sent: $00 = TPU channel 1 $01 = TPU channel 2 ... $0E = TPU channel 15 $0F = TPU channel 16

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Output mode: 0 : normal output 1 : High pulse output of length <HiLoDelay> 2 : Low pulse output of length <LoHiDelay> 3 : Pulse width modulated output with a high time of <HiLoDelay> and a low time of <LoHiDelay>

parameters.name: DigOut
parameters.description: Status of the digital output. The FBK input <DigOut> is edge sensitive. If a negative edge occurs, the output will be set to "0", if a positive edge occurs, the output will be set to "1". Important: The output can be changed any number of times during the cycle using the link and pulse functions.

parameters.description: Low time in ticks.

parameters.name: HiLoDelay
parameters.description: High time in ticks.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Communication can be started with this parameter depending on Bit 8 in the <Mode> parameter. Communication is started: Bit 8 <Mode> = 0: With a rising edge on <Start> (0->1) Bit 8 <Mode> = 1: For any FBK call with <Start> = 1

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Bit 0 ... 5: Number of bits to be transferred Bit 8: "0" <Start> edge-sensitive, "1" <Start> level-sensitive Bit 12: "0" <OutData> normal, "1" <OutData> inverted Bit 13: "1" <InData> normal, "1" <InData> inverted Bit 14: Passive state of the data lines Bit 15: Passive state of the clock lineImportant: Bits 14 and 15 are only applied during initialization!

parameters.description: Channel number of the data output Only applied during initialization.

parameters.name: InChan
parameters.description: Channel number of the data output Only applied during initialization.

parameters.name: ClockTime
parameters.description: Period length in TCR1 ticks (transfer rate)

parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value specified how the function acts for a link and when a link is sent to the <LnkChan0> or <LnkChan1> channel. Functions are bit-coded and do not exclude each other (bit = 1 - function active):When a link is received: Bit 00: A link is sent (link bridge) Bit 01: Communication is started (Data Out active) Links are sent when: Bit 02: Starting edge Bit 03: Ending edge The following bits specify the link channel for the functions ("0" <LnkChan0>, "1"“ <LnkChan1>): Bit 08: Channel for link bridge Bit 09: - Bit 10: Channel for link at the starting edge Bit 11: Channel for link at the ending edge

Functions are bit-coded and do not exclude each other (bit = 1 - function active):When a link is received: Bit 00: A link is sent (link bridge) Bit 01: Communication is started (Data Out active) Links are sent when: Bit 02: Starting edge Bit 03: Ending edge The following bits specify the link channel for the functions ("0" <LnkChan0>, "1"“ <LnkChan1>): Bit 08: Channel for link bridge Bit 09: - Bit 10: Channel for link at the starting edge Bit 11: Channel for link at the ending edge

parameters.name: LnkChan0
parameters.description: Number of the channel where links are sent

parameters.name: LnkChan1
parameters.description: Number of the channel where links are sent

parameters.name: OutData
parameters.description: Data to be transferred

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: 0x00: No error 0x01: TPU Manager not found 0x02: TPU Manager version error 0x03: Necessary TPU function not found 0x04: Incorrect I/O configuration 0x08: Incorrect value, out of range 0x10: Fatal channel management error 0x11: Channel not ready (busy) 0x20: Fatal link management error 0x21: <LnkChanX> incorrect 0x22: <LnkChanX> not ready (busy) 0x23: <LnkChanX> Function cannot receive links 0x30: Incorrect hardware for function 0x31: Incorrect hardware configuration for function 0x8000: Data channel not initialized or initialized with an incorrect function

parameters.description: Counter for complete transfers (started by <Start>, link, and via the DataIn line)

parameters.description: Counter for started transfers (<Start> or link)

parameters.description: Counter for unaccepted transfer starts (<Start> or link)

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: The function is only executed if enable is <> 0. A positive edge on <enable> (0 -> 1) results in reinitialization.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Communication can be started with this parameter depending on Bit 8 in the <Mode> parameter. Communication is started: Bit 8 <Mode> = 0: With a rising edge on <Start> (0->1) Bit 8 <Mode> = 1: For any FBK call with <Start> = 1

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Bit 0 ... 5: Number of bits to be transferred Bit 8: "0" <Start> edge-sensitive, "1" <Start> level-sensitive Bit 12: "0" <OutData> normal, "1" <OutData> inverted Bit 13: "1" <InData> normal, "1" <InData> inverted Bit 14: Passive state of the data lines Bit 15: Passive state of the clock lineImportant: Bits 14 and 15 are only applied during initialization!

parameters.description: Channel number of the data output Only applied during initialization.

parameters.name: Parameter
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: 1 : FBK is executed 0 : FBK inactive A positive edge at <enable> (0 -> 1) triggers reinitialization.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: A positive edge starts transfer. A negative edge stops transfer in continous mode (transfers in progress will be completed). Important: A positive edge will break off a transfer that is already in progress!

parameters.name: MMode
parameters.description: Bit 0 to 5: Number of bits to be transferred. Bit 14: 0 = normal clock signal 1 = inverted clock signal Bit 15: 0 = normal mode 1 = continuous mode Important: Any change will break off a transfer that is already in progress.

parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... how the function responds when a link is received. ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. The functions are bit coded. More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Links are sent: Bit 00: if a link is received (link bridge) Bit 01: if a stop edge is detected When a link is received: Bit 02: transfer is started

parameters.name: LnkChan
parameters.description: Number of the channel to which links should be sent: $00 = TPU channel 1 $01 = TPU channel 2 ... $0E = TPU channel 15 $0F = TPU channel 16

parameters.name: ClockTime
parameters.description: Period (cycle) time in ticks

parameters.name: DelayTime
parameters.description: Delay time between two transfers in continuous mode in ticks (max. $7FFF).

parameters.name: InChan
parameters.description: Bit 0 to 3: Channel number of slave input 1 (FBK for receiving data: slave input FBK LTXiss3X()). The FBK for the slave input must be called at least once before the master FBK is called. Bit 15: 0 = Slave channel inactive 1 = Slave channel active

parameters.name: OutChan
parameters.description: Bit 0 to 3: Channel number of slave output 1 (FBK for sending data: slave output FBK LTXiss2X()). The FBK for the slave output must be called at least once before the master FBK is called. Bit 15: 0 = Slave channel inactive 1 = Slave channel active

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: $00 : no error $01 : TPU manager not found $02 : TPU manager version error $03 : required function (Code) not found $04 : incorrect I/O configuration $08 : incorrect value, range exceeded $10 : fatal channel management error $11 : channel busy $20 : fatal link management error $21 : incorrect link channel (receiver) given $22 : stated link channel (receiver) busy $23 : stated link channel is not a link receiver $30 : incorrect hardware for function $31 : Incorrect hardware configuration for function

parameters.name: ErrCnt
parameters.description: Transfer error counter

parameters.name: RdyCnt
parameters.description: Successful transfer counter (stop edge)

parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... how the function responds when a link is received. ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. The functions are bit coded. parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... how the function responds when a link is received. ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. The functions are bit coded. parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: Received data

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: 1 : FBK is executed 0 : FBK inactive A positive edge at <enable> (0 -> 1) triggers reinitialization.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Bit 0 to 13: These bits are reserved. Bit 14: (only effective during initialization) 0 = normal direction 1 = inverted direction Bit 15: (only effective during initialization) 0 = half step mode 1 = full step mode

parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... how the function responds when a link is received. ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. The functions are bit coded. More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Links are sent: Bit 00: if a link is received (link bridge) Bit 01: if the comparator position is reached (<SCmp(Rel)>) When a link is received: Bit 02: movement will be stopped (corresponds to <Halt>). Bit 03: movement will be started (special function). In order to start a movement with a link, the new target position must already be read into the FBK. In move status <VStat> bit 04 will be set.

parameters.name: LnkChan
parameters.description: Number of the channel to which links should be sent: $00 = TPU channel 1 $01 = TPU channel 2 ... $0E = TPU channel 15 $0F = TPU channel 16

parameters.name: LnkPar
parameters.description: Parameters to be used when the FBK receives a link. The parameters are bit coded. More than one may be configured at one time. (Bit xx = 1 ... parameter will be used): Bit 00: <VMin> Bit 01: <VMax> Bit 02: <Accel> Bit 03: <Decel> Bit 04: <SCmp> Bit 05: <SCmpRel> Bit 06: <STarget> Bit 07: <STargetRel> Bit 15: <SRef> (referencing)

parameters.name: SetPar
parameters.description: Parameter to be used when the FBKs is called online. The parameters are bit coded. More than one may be configured at one time. (Bit xx = 1 ... parameter will be used): Bit 00: <VMin> Bit 01: <VMax> Bit 02: <Accel> Bit 03: <Decel> Bit 04: <SCmp> Bit 05: <SCmpRel> Bit 06: <STarget> Bit 07: <STargetRel> Bit 15: <SRef> (referencing)

parameters.name: Halt
parameters.description: Stop function (0 = inactive, 1 = active). A active movement can be stopped (slowed to a standstill using <Decel>). Positioning will be restarted by entering a new target position (<STarget> and/or <STargetRel>).

parameters.name: VMin
parameters.description: Start/Stop speed in Incr/sec (Vhigh >=VMin >=Vlow).

parameters.name: VMax
parameters.description: Maximum speed in Incr/sec (Vhigh >=VMax >=Vlow).

parameters.name: Accel
parameters.description: Maximum acceleration in Incr/sec2 (230 > Accel >= 0). When <Accel> is "0", movement is not started!

parameters.name: Decel
parameters.description: Maximum deceleration in Incr/sec2 (230 > Decel > 0).

parameters.name: SRef
parameters.description: Reference position. Online operation: the last actual position <SSet> will be copied to <SRef> (no position loss). Link operation: the latched position <SLatch> will be copied to <SRef> (in order to avoid loss of position, <SLatch> will be displayed uncorrected).

parameters.name: SCmp
parameters.description: Absolute comparator position. When <SCmp> is reached, a link will be sent. Note: Important: If <SCmp> is configured when ½ SSet - SCmp ½ < ½ (1 + VSet / 512 s-1) * 3½ (max. distance in 2 steps), links can be lost.

parameters.name: SCmpRel
parameters.description: Relative comparator position. Online operation: <SCmpRel> relates to the last actual position <SSet>. Link operation: <SCmpRel> relates to the latched position <SLatch>. If the absolute and relative comparator positions are read into the FBK simultaneously, <SCmpRel> will be set with respect to the absolute comparator position <SCmp>. Important: if ½SCmpRel½ < ½(1 + VSet / 512 s-1) * 3½ (max. distance in 2 steps), links can be lost.

parameters.name: STarget
parameters.description: Absolute target position.

parameters.name: STargetRel
parameters.description: Relative target position. Online operation: <STargetRel> relates to the last actual position <SSet>. Link operation: <STargetRel> relates to the latched position <SLatch>. If the absolute and relative target positions are read into the FBK simultaneously <STargetRel> will be set with respect to the absolute target position <STarget>.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: $00 : no error $01 : TPU manager not found $02 : TPU manager version error $03 : required function (Code) not found $04 : incorrect I/O configuration $08 : incorrect value, range exceeded $10 : fatal channel management error $11 : channel busy $20 : fatal link management error $21 : incorrect link channel (receiver) given $22 : stated link channel (receiver) busy $23 : stated link channel is not a link receiver $30 : incorrect hardware for function $31 : Incorrect hardware configuration for function

parameters.name: LnkStat
parameters.description: Number of links received.

parameters.name: CmpStat
parameters.description: Number of links sent due to the comparator position value being reached. Important: <CmpStat> will be incremented as soon as a new comparator value can be read into the FBK. <CmpStat> can be incremented up to ½(1 + VSet / 512 s-1) * 3½ increments (max. distance in 2 steps) before the comparator position is reached. The link does not need to be sent at this time.

parameters.name: VStat
parameters.description: Movement status: Bit 00: acceleration Bit 01: deceleration Bit 02: constant speed (not at standstill) Bit 03: end position of the last move does not correspond with the current target position. Bit 04: Wait for the start function link (special function)

parameters.name: VSet
parameters.description: Current speed in Incr/sec.

parameters.name: SLatch
parameters.description: Actual latched position when link is received. The position will normally be latched with each link received. The only exception is a link for the start function (Special function).

parameters.name: SSet

parameters.name: LnkStat
parameters.description: Number of links received.

parameters.name: CmpStat
parameters.description: Number of links sent due to the comparator position value being reached. Important: <CmpStat> will be incremented as soon as a new comparator value can be read into the FBK. <CmpStat> can be incremented up to ½(1 + VSet / 512 s-1) * 3½ increments (max. distance in 2 steps) before the comparator position is reached. The link doesn't need to be sent at this time.

parameters.name: VStat
parameters.description: Movement status: Bit 00: acceleration Bit 01: deceleration Bit 02: constant speed (not at standstill) Bit 03: end position of the last move does not correspond with the current target position. Bit 04: Wait for the start function link (special function)

parameters.name: VSet
parameters.description: Current speed in Incr/sec.

parameters.name: SLatch
parameters.description: Actual latched position when link is received. The position will normally be latched with each link received. The only exception is a link for the start function (Special function).

parameters.name: SSet
parameters.description: Current actual position.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: 1 : FBK is executed 0 : FBK inactive A positive edge at <enable> (0 -> 1) triggers reinitialization.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Bit 0 to 13: These bits are reserved. Bit 14: (only effective during initialization) 0 = normal direction 1 = inverted direction Bit 15: (only effective during initialization) Default state of frequency output 0 = low 1 = high

parameters.name: LnkMode
parameters.description: This value determines... ... how the function responds when a link is received. ... which events will send a link to channel <LnkChan>. The functions are bit coded. More than one may be active at one time (Bit xx = 1 ... function active): Links are sent: Bit 00: if a link is received (link bridge) Bit 01: if the comparator position is reached (<SCmp(Rel)>) When a link is received: Bit 02: movement will be stopped (corresponds to <Halt>). Bit 03: movement will be started (special function). In order to start a movement with a link, the new target position must already be read into the FBK. In move status <VStat> bit 04 will be set.

parameters.name: LnkChan
parameters.description: Number of the channel to which links should be sent: $00 = TPU channel 1 $01 = TPU channel 2 ... $0E = TPU channel 15 $0F = TPU channel 16

parameters.name: LnkPar
parameters.description: Parameters to be used when the FBK receives a link. The parameters are bit coded. More than one may be configured at one time. (Bit xx = 1 ... parameter will be used): Bit 00: <VMin> Bit 01: <VMax> Bit 02: <Accel> Bit 03: <Decel> Bit 04: <SCmp> Bit 05: <SCmpRel> Bit 06: <STarget> Bit 07: <STargetRel> Bit 15: <SRef> (referencing)

parameters.name: SetPar
parameters.description: Parameter to be used when the FBKs is called online. The parameters are bit coded. More than one may be configured at one time. (Bit xx = 1 ... parameter will be used): Bit 00: <VMin> Bit 01: <VMax> Bit 02: <Accel> Bit 03: <Decel> Bit 04: <SCmp> Bit 05: <SCmpRel> Bit 06: <STarget> Bit 07: <STargetRel> Bit 15: <SRef> (referencing)

parameters.name: Halt
parameters.description: Stop function (0 = inactive, 1 = active). A active movement can be stopped (slowed to a standstill using <Decel>). Positioning will be restarted by entering a new target position (<STarget> and/or <STargetRel>).

parameters.name: VMin
parameters.description: Start/Stop speed in Incr/sec (Vhigh >=VMin >=Vlow).

parameters.name: VMax
parameters.description: Maximum speed in Incr/sec (Vhigh>=VMax >=Vlow).

parameters.name: Accel
parameters.description: Maximum acceleration in Incr/sec2 (230 > Accel>=0). If <Accel> is "0", movement will not be started!

parameters.name: Decel
parameters.description: Maximum deceleration in Incr/sec2 (230 > Decel > 0).

parameters.name: SRef
parameters.description: Reference position. Online operation: the last actual position <SSet> will be copied to <SRef> (no position loss). Link operation: the latched position <SLatch> will be copied to <SRef> (in order to avoid loss of position, <SLatch> will be displayed uncorrected).

parameters.name: SCmp
parameters.description: Absolute comparator position. When <SCmp> is reached, a link will be sent.Important: If <SCmp> is configured when ½SSet - SCmp½< ½(1 + VSet / 512 s-1) * 3½ (max. distance in 2 steps), links can be lost.

parameters.name: SCmpRel
parameters.description: Relative comparator position. Online transfer: <SCmpRel> relates to the last actual position <SSet>. Link operation: <SCmpRel> relates to the latched position <SLatch>. If the absolute and relative comparator positions are read into the FBK simultaneously, <SCmpRel> will be set with respect to the absolute comparator position <SCmp>. Important: If ½SCmpRel½< ½(1 + VSet / 512 s-1) * 3½(max. distance in 2 steps), links can be lost.

parameters.name: STarget
parameters.description: Absolute target position.

parameters.name: STargetRel
parameters.description: Relative target position. Online operation: <STargetRel> relates to the last actual position <SSet>. Link operation: <STargetRel> relates to the latched position <SLatch>. If the absolute and relative target positions are read into the FBK simultaneously <STargetRel> will be set with respect to the absolute target position <STarget>.
