parameters.name: no_check
parameters.description: 0: Type control is active (standard case). Matching of length and type between remote and local objects is checked when linking. Data in these objects is transferred correctly with a Format action (byte order corrected between Intel and Motorola). Structures cannot be linked in this mode since structure descriptions are not available and a format for the correct transfer of data cannot be guaranteed. For link types inaDATAOBJ, all 1-byte data types are accepted since a dynamic data object can be regarded as a byte array. Beginning with version V1.12.2 for InaClient, InalQDrv, LoclQdrv and Commserv V2.40.2 (AR Y2.23), structures and structure arrays can be linked and then transferred correctly with regards to format. The MOTOROLA format applies as the network format (INA2000 protocol). For INTEL targets, the MOTOROLA format is modeled after using structure copy tables (corrections for byte ordering between Intel and Motorola as well as alignment correction). 1: Type checking is not active. Only the conformity of length between the remote and local object is checked when linking. In this way, structures can also be linked. However, the correct format of the transfer is not guaranteed here. Beginning with InaClient, InalQDrv, and LoclQDrv versions V1.12.2 and Commserv version V2.40.2 (AR Y2.23), structures and structure arrays can be linked and transferred in the correct format in this mode as well. parameters.name: mode

When switching from this operating mode to the operating mode LCRPID_MODE_AUTO, any existing control deviation caused by the P-element will lead to a manipulated variable jump. LCRPID_MODE_MAN_JOLTFREE, LCRPID_MODE_OPEN_JOLTFREE, LCRPID_MODE_CLOSE_JOLTFREE, LCRPID_MODE_FREEZE_JOLTFREE: Switching back to LCRPID_MODE_AUTO takes place jolt-free (i.e. no manipulated variable jump), so long as the I-element is enabled. Any control deviation at the time of switching is successively compensated by the I-element.

parameters.name: WX_max
parameters.description: Maximum input value of the reference variable W and the controlled variable X. Must be larger than WX_min. WX_min and WX_max are used for scaling the internal calculations processed in the value range between 0% and 100%. This prevents calculation inaccuracies by displaying numbers with the data type REAL. If WX_min is set to 0.0 and WX_max to 100.0, then W and X are not scaled. (Default setting) W and X are not limited to the range defined by WX_min and WX_max. The calculations will however become less accurate the more they deviate from this value range. Warning: As a rule, changing WX_min or WX_max entails changing the reinforcement on the controller!

parameters.name: WX_min
parameters.description: Minimum input value of the reference variable W and the controlled variable X. Must be less than WX_max. WX_min and WX_max are used for scaling the internal calculations processed in the value range between 0% and 100%. This prevents calculation inaccuracies by displaying numbers with the data type REAL. If WX_min is set to 0.0 and WX_max to 100.0, then W and X are not scaled. (Default setting) W and X are not limited to the range defined by WX_min and WX_max. The calculations will however become less accurate the more they deviate from this value range. Warning: As a rule, changing WX_min or WX_max entails changing the reinforcement on the controller!

parameters.name: invert
parameters.description: TRUE inverts the controller's direction of movement and can therefore implement negative gains. A positive control deviation decreases the manipulated variable Y.

parameters.name: deadband
parameters.description: Dead band. The deadband limits are defined by (W – deadband) and (W + deadband). Permitted values: 0..(WX_max – WX_min). Deadband is disabled when deadband = 0.

parameters.name: deadband_mode
parameters.description: Deadband mode: LCRPID_DEADBAND_MODE_ZERO (0): If deadband mode is enabled (deadband > 0) and if (W - deadband) < X < (W + deadband), then the controller remains active until X = W or X = W. The control deviation is not set to e = 0 until the set value W is reached. Controller output Y retains the value that was output when the set value was reached. LCRPID_DEADBAND_MODE_STANDARD (1): If deadband mode is enabled (deadband > 0) and if (W - deadband) < X < (W + deadband), the controller deviation e is set to 0 internally. Controller output Y retains the value that was output when the deadband mode began. LCRPID_DEADBAND_MODE_STANDARD_I (2): Sames as the mode LCRPID_DEADBAND_MODE_STANDARD, however, after leaving the deadband, the integral element calculates the control deviation e as 'W - X ± deadband' instead of 'W - X'.

parameters.name: dY_max
parameters.description: Maximum manipulated variable ramp (rate of change of the manipulated variable). Units: % / seconds. The ramp is disabled at 0 and does not require any computing time.

parameters.name: Kp
parameters.description: Proportional gain. Units: [%/%]. Permitted values: Kp > 0.0. Negative gains are configured by setting the input invert = TRUE. The control error e = W - X is also scaled when scaling the set value W and the actual value X between WX_min and WX_max, whereby e = 100% is equal to a control deviation of (W - X) = (WX_max - WX_min). Kp [%/%] = k_p * (WX_max - WX_min)/100 must be defined to implement a proportional gain k_p [%/(unit of W and X)], which is specified as a relationship between the manipulated variable percentage and a control deviation in physical units of the controlled variable. Example for calculating Kp.

parameters.name: Tn
parameters.description: Integral action time (I-element). Units: Seconds. The time span, which a constant control deviation must meet for the I-element to generate the same manipulated variable as the P-element. The integral element and jolt-free switching are disabled at 0 and do not require any computing time.

parameters.name: Tv
parameters.description: Derivative action time (D-element). Units: Seconds. The time span, which a increasing control deviation of 0 with a constant gradient must meet for the P-element to generate the same manipulated variable as the D-element. The derivative element is disabled at 0 and does not require any computing time. Otherwise, Tv > Tf > 1.4 * dt (controller scan-time, cycle time) must be the case.

parameters.name: Tf
parameters.description: Filter time for the derivative element. Units: Seconds. Must be specified if Tv is not equal to 0. If Tf is less than 1.4 * dt (controller scan time, cycle time) during runtime, then the LC_WARN_Tx_DT warning is output to LCRPID() and calculation takes place with the replacement value 1.4 * dt.

parameters.name: Kw
parameters.description: Set value attenuation. The attenuator is disabled at 1 and does not require any computing time.

parameters.name: Kfbk
parameters.description: Windup damping. The windup protection is disabled at 0 and does not require any computing time.

parameters.name: fbk_mode
parameters.description: Feedback mode for the manipulated variable: LCRPID_FBK_MODE_INTERN: Internal. LCRPID_FBK_MODE_EXTERN: External for release control. LCRPID_FBK_MODE_LIMIT_YI: The I element is stopped if Yp + Yi + Yd ≥ Ymax - A or Yp + Yi + Yd ≤ Ymin + A. Kfbk does not affect this type of windup protection.

parameters.name: d_mode
parameters.description: Differentiator mode:LCRPID_D_MODE_X: Only -X (actual value)LCRPID_D_MODE_E: e (control deviation, as for a standard PID controller)

parameters.name: P_manualAdjust
parameters.description: % Fine adjustment of the proportional gain (-99% to +10000%). To be occupied first with the value 0. Then the control response can be adjusted manually to the auto-tuning if needed. Positive values increase, negative values decrease the controller gain by the corresponding percentage. Important: A Kp controller gain of less than 1 is not allowed.

parameters.name: I_manualAdjust
parameters.description: % Fine adjustment of the integral element (-100% to +10000%). To be occupied first with the value 0. Then the control response can be adjusted manually to the auto-tuning if needed. Positive values accelerate, negative decelerate the integral element by the corresponding percentage. The integral element is shut off at -100%.

parameters.name: D_manualAdjust
parameters.description: % Fine adjustment of the derivative element (-100% to +10000%). To be occupied first with the value 0. Then the control response can be adjusted manually to the auto-tuning if needed. Positive values gain, negative lessen the derivative element by the corresponding percentage. The derivative element is shut off at -100%.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: -- Autotuning request: LCPIDAUTOTUNE_REQU_OFF: Auto-tuning inactive, controller is released. LCPIDAUTOTUNE_REQU_STEPRESPONSE: Auto-tuning for the reference ratio only (with the exception of a step-response). LCPIDAUTOTUNE_REQU_OSCILLATE: Auto-tuning of the disturbance ratio by enabling the system to oscillate. LCPIDAUTOTUNE_REQU_AUTOTUNE: Auto-tuning the reference ratio and then the disturbance ratio.

parameters.name: basetime
parameters.description: -- Has to be connected to one of the outputs of the LCCounter() function block. Depending on the selected LCCounter() output, you have the base time which is specified in the description of that particular LCCounter() output. The same clock must be connected as for the accompanying controller LCPID(). 1 msec is recommended for base time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: -- Function block status report LC_ERR_LCPIDAutoTune_ABORT: Auto-tuning aborted because request shut off before state was FINISHED. LC_ERR_LCPIDAutoTune_W_CHANGED: Auto-tuning aborted because W changed off before state was FINISHED. LC_ERR_LCPIDAutoTune_TIMEOUT: Auto-tuning abort because the time addpar.t_autotune_max expired before completion. LC_ERR_LCPIDAutoTune_PARAMETER: Error calculating the control parameters (see addInfo output). Others: see Error numbers(0 = no error).

parameters.name: ident
parameters.description: -- Ident for LCPID(). Address of the parameter structure with the control parameters in internal representation.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: This function block is only executed if enable = TRUE. Otherwise, all outputs (including ident!) are set to 0.

parameters.name: enter
parameters.description: Control parameters are only checked and converted into an internal representation when this input is TRUE. Otherwise, modifications to the parameter inputs are ignored and computing time can be saved.

parameters.name: Y_max
parameters.description: Upper manipulated variable limit. Limits the modulation of Yi and Y to a smaller area than the maximum possible -32768 to +32767. Must be greater than Y_min.

parameters.name: Y_min
parameters.description: Lower manipulated variable limit. Limits the modulation of Yi and Y to a smaller area than the maximum possible -32768 to +32767. Must be less than Y_max.

parameters.name: dY_max
parameters.description: Maximum manipulated variable ramp (rate of change of the manipulated variable). Units: 1 / unit of the base time. The ramp is disabled at 0 and does not require any computing time.

parameters.name: Kp
parameters.description: Proportional gain. Allowed values: Kp > 0.0.

parameters.name: Tn
parameters.description: Integral action time (I-part) in units of the base time. The time span, which a constant control deviation must meet for the I-part to generate the same manipulated variable as the P-part. The integral element and jolt-free switching are disabled at 0 and do not require any computing time.

parameters.name: Tv
parameters.description: Derivative action time (D-part) in units of the base time. The time span, which a increasing control deviation of 0 with a constant gradient must meet for the P-part to generate the same manipulated variable as the D-part. The derivative element is disabled at 0 and does not require any computing time. Otherwise, Tv > Tf > 1.4 * dt (controller scan-time, cycle time) must be the case.

parameters.name: Tf
parameters.description: Filter time (D-part) in units of the base time. Must be specified if Tv is not equal to 0. If Tf is less than 1.4 * dt (controller scan time, cycle time) during runtime, then the LC_WARN_Tx_DT warning is output to LCPID() and calculation takes place with the replacement value 1.4 * dt.

parameters.name: Kw
parameters.description: Set value attenuation. The attenuator is disabled at 1 and does not require any computing time.

parameters.name: Kfbk
parameters.description: Windup damping. The windup protection is disabled at 0 and does not require any computing time.

parameters.name: fbk_mode
parameters.description: Feedback mode for the manipulated variable: LCPID_FBK_MODE_INTERN: InternalLCPID_FBK_MODE_EXTERN: External for release control LCPID_FBK_MODE_EXT_SELECTOR: External for selector control. In this mode, the integral element of the controller not select at the moment (Y_fbk ? Y) follows the Y_fbk input according to the formula Yi = Y_fbk – Yp – Yd – A.

parameters.name: d_mode
parameters.description: Differentiator mode:LCPID_D_MODE_X: only -X (actual value)LCPID_D_MODE_E: e (control deviation, as for a standard PID controller)

parameters.name: calc_mode
parameters.description: Calculating mode: LCPID_CALC_MODE_EXACT: Exact (calculations are double floating, i.e. no rounding errors and long computing times on SG3). LCPID_CALC_MODE_FAST: Fast (all calculations are integers with fixed-point arithmetic - minor rounding errors may occur - fast computing times on SG3).

parameters.name: P_manaualAdjust
parameters.description: Fine adjustment of the proportional gain. Allowed values: -99..+10000 [%]. The controller behavior can by adjusted manually if necessary.Positive values increase, negative values decrease the controller gain by the corresponding percentage.

parameters.name: I_manualAdjust
parameters.description: Fine adjustment of the integral element.Allowed values: -100..+10000 [%].The controller behavior can be adjusted manually if necessary. Positive values accelerate, negative decelerate the integral element by the corresponding percentage. The I ration is shut off at -100%.

parameters.name: D_manualAdjust
parameters.description: Fine adjustment of the derivative element.Allowed values: -100..+10000 [%].The controller behavior can be adjusted manually if necessary. Positive values gain, negative lessen the derivative element by the corresponding percentage. The D ratio is shut off at -100%.

parameters.name: t_min_pulse
parameters.description: Minimum duration of the output actuator pulses and pauses. Allowed values: 0 to 65535 units for the base time. The actual dt cycle time of the function block call should not be greater than the value of t_min_pulse. (Exception: t_min_pulse = 0) The function block must be reinitialized if t_min_pulse is changed!

parameters.name: t_period
parameters.description: Period for the output actuator pulses. The sum of the idle period and pulse length is limited to at least the value of t_period as an additional condition. Allowed values: 1..65535 Units of the base time. If t_period = t_min_pulse, then the function block works as a pulse density modulator. In this case, neither the pulse duration nor the period duration is specified. Both depend on the current input value. The pulse density changes each time the x input changes. When t_period > t_min_pulse, then x is changed right after the current period has expired.
